title: BrainVista: Modeling Naturalistic Brain Dynamics as Multimodal Next-Token Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2602.04512v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Naturalistic fMRI offers a time-resolved window into cortical dynamics during continuous multimodal experience, where future brain states are jointly governed by endogenous neural context and exogenous sensory drive. Forecasting such dynamics, however, remains challenging because fast-changing stimulus streams must be reconciled with the sluggish hemodynamic BOLD response, while cortical activity is organized across functionally heterogeneous brain networks. To address these challenges, we introduce BrainVista, a multimodal autoregressive framework for observed-stimulus conditional brain-state forecasting. BrainVista predicts future fMRI states from the history of brain activity and stimulus tokens temporally aligned to each prediction query, enabling autoregressive prediction without access to future ground-truth fMRI states. Recursive rollout provides a within-run predictive test of brain-state evolution under continuing sens

translated_title: BrainVista：将自然主义大脑动态建模为多模态下一词元预测
translated_abstract: 自然主义fMRI为连续多模态体验期间的皮层动态提供了时间分辨的观察窗口，其中未来大脑状态由内在神经上下文与外在感觉驱动共同决定。然而，预测这种动态仍面临挑战：快速变化的刺激流必须与缓慢的血流动力学BOLD响应相协调，同时皮层活动又分布于功能异质的大脑网络之中。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了BrainVista——一个用于观察刺激条件下大脑状态预测的多模态自回归框架。BrainVista基于大脑活动历史以及与每个预测查询在时间上对齐的刺激词元来预测未来的fMRI状态，从而在无需访问未来真实fMRI状态的情况下实现自回归预测。递归展开机制为持续感觉输入下大脑状态的演化提供了单次运行内的预测性检验……
tldr: BrainVista提出了一种将自然主义大脑动态建模为多模态“下一词元预测”的自回归框架，通过历史大脑活动与时间对齐的刺激词元来预测未来fMRI状态，无需未来真实数据即可实现大脑状态演化的自回归预测。
en_tdlr: BrainVista introduces a multimodal autoregressive framework that models naturalistic brain dynamics as multimodal next-token prediction, forecasting future fMRI brain states from historical brain activity and temporally aligned stimulus tokens without access to future ground-truth data.
